d: sickness comes like a landslide, but goes slowly like spinning silk (idiom); expect to convalesce slowly
t: 病來如山倒，病去如抽絲

w: 发热伴血小板减少综合征
r: fā rè bàn xuè xiǎo bǎn jiǎn shǎo zōng hé zhēng
t: 發熱伴血小板減少綜合徵

w: 百胜难虑敌，三折乃良医
r: bǎi shèng nán lù: dí , sān zhé nǎi liáng yī
d: (a line from a poem by the Tang poet Liu Yuxi 劉禹錫|刘禹锡[Liu2 Yu3 xi1]) one gains very little insight into one's enemy from a hundred victories, but he who breaks his arm three times will be a good doctor
(fig.) one learns more from one's failures than from one's successes
t: 百勝難慮敵，三折乃良醫

w: 礼轻人意重，千里送鹅毛
r: lǐ qīng rén yì zhòng , qiān lǐ sòng é máo
d: goose feather sent from afar, a slight present but weighty meaning (idiom); It's not the present the counts, it's the thought behind it.
t: 禮輕人意重，千里送鵝毛

w: 秀才不出门，全知天下事
r: xiù cai bù chū mén , quán zhī tiān xià shì
d: a learned person need not leave his home to know what's going on in the world (idiom)
t: 秀才不出門，全知天下事

w: 秀才不出门，能知天下事
r: xiù cai bù chū mén , néng zhī tiān xià shì
d: a learned person need not leave his home to know what's going on in the world (idiom)
t: 秀才不出門，能知天下事

w: 老鼠拖木锨，大头在后头
r: lǎo shǔ tuō mù xiān , dà tóu zài hòu tou
d: when the mice drag a shovel, the biggest thing comes second
t: 老鼠拖木鍁，大頭在後頭

w: 听君一席话，胜读十年书
r: tīng jūn yī xí huà , shèng dú shí nián shū
d: listening to the words of a wise man can be superior to studying ten years of books (proverb)
t: 聽君一席話，勝讀十年書

w: 临渊羡鱼，不如退而结网
r: lín yuān xiàn yú , bù rú tuì ér jié wǎng
d: better to go home and weave a net than to stand by the pond longing for fish (idiom)
one should take practical steps to achieve one's aim
t: 臨淵羨魚，不如退而結網

w: 台上一分钟，台下十年功
r: tái shàng yī fēn zhōng , tái xià shí nián gōng
d: ten years of practice for one minute on the stage (idiom)
t: 臺上一分鐘，臺下十年功

w: 花有重开日，人无再少年
r: huā yǒu chóng kāi rì , rén wú zài shào nián
d: a flower may blossom again, but a person cannot get young again (proverb)
t: 花有重開日，人無再少年

w: 若要人不知，除非己莫为
r: ruò yào rén bù zhī , chú fēi jǐ mò wéi
d: If you don't want anyone to know, don't do it (idiom). fig. If you do something bad, people will inevitably hear about it.
t: 若要人不知，除非己莫為

w: 见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话
r: jiàn rén shuō rén huà , jiàn guǐ shuō guǐ huà
d: (fig.) adaptable; able to deal with various kinds of people and situations
t: 見人說人話，見鬼說鬼話

w: 谁笑到最后，谁笑得最好
r: shéi xiào dào zuì hòu , shéi xiào dé zuì hǎo
d: He laughs best who laughs last.
t: 誰笑到最後，誰笑得最好

w: 谁笑在最后，谁笑得最好
r: shéi xiào zài zuì hòu , shéi xiào dé zuì hǎo
d: He laughs best who laughs last.
t: 誰笑在最後，誰笑得最好

w: 路遥知马力，日久见人心
r: lù yáo zhī mǎ lì , rì jiǔ jiàn rén xīn
d: just as distance determines the stamina of a horse, so does time reveal a person's true heart (proverb)
t: 路遙知馬力，日久見人心

w: 躲得过初一，躲不过十五
r: duǒ de guò chū yī , duǒ bù guò shí wǔ
d: lit. you may go undetected during the new moon, but at full moon you'll be found out (idiom)
fig. you can't put it off forever
sooner or later you'll have to deal with it
t: 躲得過初一，躲不過十五

w: 农村家庭联产承包责任制
r: nóng cūn jiā tíng lián chǎn chéng bāo zé rèn zhì
d: rural household contract responsibility system, PRC government policy linking rural income to productivity
t: 農村家庭聯產承包責任制

w: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
r: yě huǒ shāo bù jìn , chūn fēng chuī yòu shēng
d: lit. even a prairie fire cannot destroy the grass - it grows again when the breeze blows (proverb)
abbr. to 野火春風|野火春风[ye3 huo3 chun1 feng1]
t: 野火燒不盡，春風吹又生

w: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝
r: jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō
t: 金窩銀窩不如自己的狗窩

w: 顶港有名声，下港上出名
r: dǐng gǎng yǒu míng shēng , xià gǎng shàng chū míng
d: (Tw) (saying) famous far and wide (from Taiwanese Hokkien)
t: 頂港有名聲，下港上出名

w: 饭后一支烟，赛过活神仙
r: fàn hòu yī zhī yān , sài guò huó shén xiān
d: have a smoke after each meal and you will surpass the immortals (proverb)
t: 飯後一支煙，賽過活神仙

w: 饭后百步走，活到九十九
r: fàn hòu bǎi bù zǒu , huó dào jiǔ shí jiǔ
d: walk a hundred steps after each meal and you will live a long life (proverb)
t: 飯後百步走，活到九十九

w: 饱暖思淫欲，饥寒起盗心
r: bǎo nuǎn sī yín yù , jī hán qǐ dào xīn
d: lechery springs from warmth and nourishment, kleptomania springs from hunger and cold (idiom)
t: 飽暖思淫欲，飢寒起盜心

w: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量
r: rén bù kě mào xiàng , hǎi shuǐ bù kě dǒu liáng
d: you can't judge a person by appearance, just as you can't measure the sea with a pint pot (idiom)

w: 人非生而知之者，孰能无惑
r: rén fēi shēng ér zhī zhī zhě , shú néng wú huò
d: Knowledge is not innate to man, how can we overcome doubt?
We are not born with knowledge, how does one achieve maturity? (i.e. without guidance from a teacher - Tang dynasty essayist Han Yu 韓愈|韩愈[Han2 Yu4])
t: 人非生而知之者，孰能無惑

w: 以其人之道，还治其人之身
r: yǐ qí rén zhī dào , huán zhì qí rén zhī shēn
d: to use an opponent's own methods to obtain retribution (idiom, from Song dynasty neo-Confucianist Zhu Xi 朱熹[Zhu1 Xi1])
to get revenge by playing sb back at his own game; to give sb a taste of his own medicine
t: 以其人之道，還治其人之身

w: 千里马常有，而伯乐不常有
r: qiān lǐ mǎ cháng yǒu , ér Bó lè bù cháng yǒu
d: (lit.) there are many swift horses, but very few who can spot them (proverb)
(fig.) many have talent, but few can recognize talent when they see it
t: 千里馬常有，而伯樂不常有

w: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准
r: shí jiàn shì jiǎn yàn zhēn lǐ de wéi yī biāo zhǔn
d: Actual practice is the sole criterion for judging truth (item from Deng Xiaoping theory, from 1978)
t: 實踐是檢驗真理的唯一標準

w: 端起碗吃肉，放下筷子骂娘
r: duān qǐ wǎn chī ròu , fàng xià kuài zi mà niáng
d: lit. to eat meat from one's bowl, then put down one's chopsticks and scold one's mother (idiom)
fig. to complain despite being privileged
to be ungrateful for what one has been given
t: 端起碗吃肉，放下筷子罵娘

w: 虱子多了不痒，债多了不愁
r: shī zi duō le bù yǎng , zhài duō le bù chóu
d: (lit.) when covered with lice, one doesn't feel the itching anymore, and when up to one's ears in debt, one ceases to worry about it (saying)
t: 虱子多了不癢，債多了不愁

w: 黄鼠狼给鸡拜年，没安好心
r: huáng shǔ láng gěi jī bài nián , méi ān hǎo xīn
d: see 黃鼠狼給雞拜年|黄鼠狼给鸡拜年[huang2 shu3 lang2 gei3 ji1 bai4 nian2]
t: 黃鼠狼給雞拜年，沒安好心

w: 一部二十四史，不知从何说起
r: yī bù èr shí sì shǐ , bù zhī cóng hé shuō qǐ
d: It's a long and intricate story, I hardly know where to start.
t: 一部二十四史，不知從何說起

w: 三个臭皮匠，胜过一个诸葛亮
r: sān gè chòu pí jiang , shèng guò yī gè Zhū gě Liàng
d: variant of 三個臭皮匠，賽過一個諸葛亮|三个臭皮匠，赛过一个诸葛亮[san1 ge4 chou4 pi2 jiang5 , sai4 guo4 yi1 ge4 Zhu1 ge3 Liang4]
t: 三個臭皮匠，勝過一個諸葛亮

w: 三个臭皮匠，合成一个诸葛亮
r: sān gè chòu pí jiang , hé chéng yī gè Zhū gě Liàng
d: lit. three ignorant cobblers add up to a genius (idiom); fig. collective wisdom
t: 三個臭皮匠，合成一個諸葛亮

w: 三个臭皮匠，赛过一个诸葛亮
r: sān gè chòu pí jiang , sài guò yī gè Zhū gě Liàng
d: lit. three ignorant cobblers add up to a genius (idiom); fig. collective wisdom
wisdom of the masses exceeds that of any individual
t: 三個臭皮匠，賽過一個諸葛亮

w: 人无横财不富，马无夜草不肥
r: rén wú hèng cái bù fù , mǎ wú yè cǎo bù féi
d: (saying) a person cannot become wealthy without windfall profits (or ill-gotten gains etc), just as a horse cannot get fat without night feed
t: 人無橫財不富，馬無夜草不肥

w: 公民权利和政治权利国际公约
r: gōng mín quán lì hé zhèng zhì quán lì guó jì gōng yuē
d: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR)
t: 公民權利和政治權利國際公約

w: 刀不磨要生锈，人不学要落后
r: dāo bù mó yào shēng xiù , rén bù xué yào luò hòu
d: (proverb) a blade will get rusty if it is not sharpened; a man will fall behind if he doesn't study
t: 刀不磨要生鏽，人不學要落後

w: 千里搭长棚，没有不散的宴席
r: qiān lǐ dā cháng péng , méi yǒu bù sàn de yàn xí
d: even if you build a thousand-league awning for it, every banquet must come to an end (idiom)
t: 千里搭長棚，沒有不散的宴席

w: 又要马儿好，又要马儿不吃草
r: yòu yào mǎ r hǎo , yòu yào mǎ r bù chī cǎo
d: see 又要馬兒跑，又要馬兒不吃草|又要马儿跑，又要马儿不吃草[you4 yao4 ma3 r5 pao3 , you4 yao4 ma3 r5 bu4 chi1 cao3]
t: 又要馬兒好，又要馬兒不吃草

w: 又要马儿跑，又要马儿不吃草
r: yòu yào mǎ r pǎo , yòu yào mǎ r bù chī cǎo
d: lit. you can't expect the horse to run fast but not let it graze (idiom)
fig. you can't have your cake and eat it, too
t: 又要馬兒跑，又要馬兒不吃草

w: 只许州官放火，不许百姓点灯
r: zhǐ xǔ zhōu guān fàng huǒ , bù xǔ bǎi xìng diǎn dēng
d: only the official is allowed to light the fire
Gods may do what cattle may not
quod licet Iovi, non licet bovi
t: 只許州官放火，不許百姓點燈

w: 吃人家的嘴软，拿人家的手短
r: chī rén jiā de zuǐ ruǎn , ná rén jiā de shǒu duǎn
d: lit. the mouth that has been fed by others is soft, the hand that has received doesn't reach (idiom)
fig. one is partial to those from whom presents have been accepted
t: 吃人家的嘴軟，拿人家的手短

w: 士为知己者死，女为悦己者容
r: shì wèi zhī jǐ zhě sǐ , nǔ: wèi yuè jǐ zhě róng
d: a true gentleman will sacrifice his life for a friend who understands him, as a woman makes herself beautiful for her sweetheart
t: 士為知己者死，女為悅己者容

w: 天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福
r: tiān yǒu bù cè fēng yún , rén yǒu dàn xī huò fú
d: fortune as unpredictable as the weather, every day may bring fortune or calamity (idiom); sth unexpected may happen at any moment
t: 天有不測風雲，人有旦夕禍福

w: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆
r: xué ér bù sī zé wǎng , sī ér bù xué zé dài
d: To learn without thinking is confusing, to think without learning is dangerous (Confucius)
t: 學而不思則罔，思而不學則殆

w: 舍得一身剐，敢把皇帝拉下马
r: shě de yī shēn guǎ , gǎn bǎ huáng dì lā xià mǎ
d: one who does not fear the death of thousand cuts will dare to unhorse the emperor (proverb)
to a fearless person, no fence is high enough
t: 捨得一身剮，敢把皇帝拉下馬

w: 水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒
r: shuǐ zhì qīng zé wú yú , rén zhì chá zé wú tú
d: (saying) water that is too clear has no fish, and one who is too severe has no friends
t: 水至清則無魚，人至察則無徒

w: 经济社会及文化权利国际公约
r: jīng jì shè huì jí wén huà quán lì guó jì gōng yuē
d: International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR)
t: 經濟社會及文化權利國際公約

w: 虚心使人进步，骄傲使人落后
r: xū xīn shǐ rén jìn bù , jiāo ào shǐ rén luò hòu
d: modesty leads to progress, arrogance makes you fall behind (quote of Mao Zedong)
t: 虛心使人進步，驕傲使人落後

w: 运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外
r: yùn chóu wéi wò zhī zhōng , jué shèng qiān lǐ zhī wài
d: a general planning in the seclusion of his tent is able to determine the outcome of the distant battle (idiom)
t: 運籌帷幄之中，決勝千里之外

w: 当官不为民做主不如回家卖红薯
r: dāng guān bù wèi mín zuò zhǔ bù rú huí jiā mài hóng shǔ
d: if an official does not put the people first, he might as well go home and sell sweet potatoes
t: 當官不為民做主不如回家賣紅薯

w: 一寸光阴一寸金，寸金难买寸光阴
r: yī cùn guāng yīn yī cùn jīn , cùn jīn nán mǎi cùn guāng yīn
d: (lit.) an interval of time is worth an ounce of gold, money cannot buy you time (saying)
t: 一寸光陰一寸金，寸金難買寸光陰

w: 不管白猫黑猫，捉住老鼠就是好猫
r: bù guǎn bái māo hēi māo , zhuō zhù lǎo shǔ jiù shì hǎo māo
d: it doesn't matter whether a cat is white or black; as long as it catches mice it's a good cat (variant of a Sichuanese saying used in a speech by Deng Xiaoping 鄧小平|邓小平[Deng4 Xiao3 ping2] in 1962, usually associated with his economic reforms starting in 1978, in which pragmatism was favored over ideological purity)
t: 不管白貓黑貓，捉住老鼠就是好貓

w: 你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥
r: nǐ zǒu nǐ de Yáng guān Dào , wǒ guò wǒ de dú mù qiáo
d: lit. you hit the high road, I'll cross the log bridge (idiom)
fig. you go your way, I'll go mine
you do it your way, I'll do it mine
t: 你走你的陽關道，我過我的獨木橋

w: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐
r: xiān tiān xià zhī yōu ér yōu , hòu tiān xià zhī lè ér lè
d: to be the first to worry about affairs of state, and the last to enjoy oneself (quotation from the essay On Yueyang Tower 岳陽樓記|岳阳楼记[Yue4 yang2 Lou2 Ji4] by Song writer Fan Zhongyan 范仲淹[Fan4 Zhong4 yan1])
t: 先天下之憂而憂，後天下之樂而樂

w: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他家瓦上霜
r: gè rén zì sǎo mén qián xuě , mò guǎn tā jiā wǎ shàng shuāng
d: sweep the snow from your own door step, don't worry about the frost on your neighbor's roof (idiom)
t: 各人自掃門前雪，莫管他家瓦上霜

w: 害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无
r: hài rén zhī xīn bù kě yǒu , fáng rén zhī xīn bù kě wú
d: refrain from hurting others, yet guard against those trying to hurt you (proverb)
t: 害人之心不可有，防人之心不可無

w: 平生不做亏心事，半夜敲门心不惊
r: píng shēng bù zuò kuī xīn shì , bàn yè qiāo mén xīn bù jīng
d: He who never wrongs others does not fear the knock in the night.
t: 平生不做虧心事，半夜敲門心不驚

w: 书中自有黄金屋，书中自有颜如玉
r: shū zhōng zì yǒu huáng jīn wū , shū zhōng zì yǒu yán rú yù
d: lit. in books are sumptuous houses and graceful ladies (proverb)
fig. be diligent in your studies, success and glory will follow
t: 書中自有黃金屋，書中自有顏如玉

w: 曾经沧海难为水，除却巫山不是云
r: céng jīng cāng hǎi nán wéi shuǐ , chú què Wū Shān bù shì yún
d: there are no rivers to one who has crossed the ocean, and no clouds to one who has passed Mount Wu (idiom)
one who has seen the world doesn't stop at small things
t: 曾經滄海難為水，除卻巫山不是雲

w: 有仇不报非君子，有冤不伸枉为人
r: yǒu chóu bù bào fēi jūn zǐ , yǒu yuān bù shēn wǎng wéi rén
d: one who doesn't avenge an injustice is not a gentleman, one who doesn't redress a wrong is not a man (idiom)
t: 有仇不報非君子，有冤不伸枉為人

w: 有意栽花花不发，无心插柳柳成阴
r: yǒu yì zāi huā huā bù fā , wú xīn chā liǔ liǔ chéng yīn
d: lit. you plant a garden and the flowers do not bloom, you poke a stick in the mud and it grows into a tree
fig. things do not always turn out as one would expect
well-laid plans may fail, and success may come where you least expect it
t: 有意栽花花不發，無心插柳柳成陰

w: 机关算尽太聪明，反算了卿卿性命
r: jī guān suàn jìn tài cōng ming , fǎn suàn le qīng qīng xìng mìng
d: if one is too calculating, it will be the cause of one's own undoing (famous line in "A Dream of Red Mansions" 紅樓夢|红楼梦[Hong2 lou2 Meng4])
t: 機關算盡太聰明，反算了卿卿性命

w: 穷在闹市无人问，富在深山有远亲
r: qióng zài nào shì wú rén wèn , fù zài shēn shān yǒu yuǎn qīn
d: the poor are ignored in the busiest city; the rich will find relatives in the deepest mountain
t: 窮在鬧市無人問，富在深山有遠親

w: 老子英雄儿好汉，老子反动儿混蛋
r: lǎo zi yīng xióng ér hǎo hàn , lǎo zi fǎn dòng ér hún dàn
d: If the father is a hero, the son is a real man. If the father is a reactionary, the son is a bastard. (Cultural Revolution slogan)
t: 老子英雄兒好漢，老子反動兒混蛋

w: 踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费工夫
r: tà pò tiě xié wú mì chù , dé lái quán bù fèi gōng fu
d: to travel far and wide looking for sth, only to find it easily
